title: Generalized Geometry Block Proximal Linearized Method for Multiblock Nonconvex and Nonsmooth Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.39301v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper considers a class of multiblock nonconvex and nonsmooth optimization problems arising in many applications. Existing methods construct proximal linearized operators or their variants within standard Euclidean geometry to solve this class of problems, forcing their block variable updates to rely on the standard inner product and its induced norm. Nevertheless, this construction fails to capture the geometric structure of the target problem, leading to low numerical efficiency. To overcome these drawbacks, we propose a generalized geometry proximal linearized operator for updating block variables, and develop the Generalized Geometry Block Proximal Linearized (GGBPL) method based on this operator. translated_title: 面向多块非凸非光滑优化的广义几何块近端线性化方法
translated_abstract: 本文考虑了一类在众多应用中出现的多块非凸非光滑优化问题。现有方法在标准欧氏几何框架内构造近端线性化算子或其变体来求解此类问题，使得块变量的更新被迫依赖于标准内积及其诱导范数。然而，这种构造方式无法捕捉目标问题的几何结构，导致数值效率低下。为克服这些缺陷，我们提出了一种用于更新块变量的广义几何近端线性化算子，并基于该算子发展了广义几何块近端线性化方法。与现有的近端线性化算子相比，所提出的算子允许使用任意内积和一般容许度量来构造块代理函数，从而使GGBPL方法能够适应问题的内在几何结构（摘要至此被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出广义几何块近端线性化方法，通过允许用任意内积和一般容许度量构造块代理函数，突破了传统欧氏几何框架的局限，显著提升了多块非凸非光滑优化问题的求解效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Generalized Geometry Block Proximal Linearized (GGBPL) method, which enables block surrogate functions to be constructed with arbitrary inner products and general admissible metrics, overcoming the limitations of standard Euclidean geometry for multiblock nonconvex and nonsmooth optimization.
